purpose: Tracks, per G20+ expansion candidate, whether each required source-authority category has an official source identified and/or verified on file. This file records research state only. It never grants publication status — that happens exclusively through the existing data/rules/<slug>.json six-gate pipeline.

intake_status_model_notes.not_started: No candidate authority has been identified for this category yet.
intake_status_model_notes.identified: A plausible official authority name is known (public knowledge), but no specific official source URL has been fetched, dated, or cited yet.
intake_status_model_notes.needs_verification: A source URL exists from prior internal research but has not been re-checked for current reachability/effective text under this intake process.
intake_status_model_notes.verified_on_file: A specific official source URL is already recorded in the corresponding data/rules/<slug>.json source_authorities and was live-verified during that entry's own research (per the existing six-gate pipeline) — restated here for tracking only, not re-verified by this file.
intake_status_model_notes.not_applicable: This source category is not currently believed to be needed for this candidate's currency-passage rules (starting assumption only, may change once research begins).

central_bank_or_monetary_authority.label: Bank of Korea (BOK) — Foreign Exchange System / Foreign Exchange Transactions Act (with the Ministry of Economy and Finance)
central_bank_or_monetary_authority.note: P8F-1 live-verified 2026-07-24: BOK Foreign Exchange System pages (bok.or.kr/eng, menuNo=400187 Relevant Legislation, 400191 Payments and Transactions, 400195 Internationalization of the Korean Won). The Foreign Exchange Transactions Act (FETA) regulates the exchange-rate system, FX operations, payment/receipt of FX and capital movements; capital transactions accompanying large fund movements follow separate transaction-type reporting procedures (e.g. reported to the Bank of Korea Governor / MOEF / a foreign exchange bank), and banks notify the National Tax Administration for FX sales over USD 10,000 same person/day. Current account is liberalised; the capital account is a notification/reporting regime, NOT fully free, and the Korean won is not fully internationalized. FINDING: the on-file exchange_controls/overview claim (no general exchange controls; fully liberalised for both current and capital account) is OVERSTATED and must be corrected at P8F-2. Administered by MOEF + BOK; FETA text on law.go.kr.

customs_or_border_authority.label: Korea Customs Service — traveller foreign-currency declaration (Foreign Exchange Transactions Act basis)
customs_or_border_authority.note: P8F-1 live-verified 2026-07-24 via the official Korea Customs pages (customs.go.kr/english): a traveller entering or leaving Korea with foreign currency, Korean-won notes or checks (means of payment) exceeding USD 10,000 in total MUST report it to Customs — mark item no. 3 on the Traveler Declaration Form, submit it, and receive the Certificate of Foreign Currency Declaration; below USD 10,000 no permission or declaration is required. Legal basis: Foreign Exchange Transactions Act. URLs: customs.go.kr/english/cm/cntnts/cntntsView.do?mi=10800&cntntsId=5500 (declaration of foreign currency) and mi=10802&cntntsId=5503 (Traveler Declaration Form). FINDING: the on-file cash_declaration_threshold (No mandatory currency declaration threshold) and bring_foreign_currency_in (should be prepared to declare if questioned) are INCORRECT — the USD 10,000 declaration is mandatory — and must be corrected at P8F-2. DISTINCT from FETA capital-transaction reporting and from KoFIU AML. P8F-2 done 2026-07-24: data/rules/south-korea.json corrected. Declaration cluster CLOSED to the Korea Customs page (mandatory declaration for means of payment exceeding USD 10,000; Traveler Declaration Form item 3; Certificate). exchange_controls/overview/banking CLOSED to BOK Foreign Exchange System guidance (FETA three-area structure; capital notification/permission; foreign exchange banks; won not fully internationalised). resident/non_resident/business/summary.business remain [HARDENING] (exact FETA articles JS-gated on law.go.kr/KLRI). South Korea HELD at source_review_ready. P8F-2b done 2026-07-24: the four remaining fields CLOSED on the controlling FETA text via the KLRI official English reference translation (elaw.klri.re.kr eng_mobile viewer serves the article body) — FETA Art. 8 (foreign exchange business), Art. 15 (payment procedures/permission), Art. 16 (methods of payment or receipt reporting), Art. 18 (capital-transaction reporting), Art. 23 (delegation to BOK Governor/FSC/foreign exchange agencies); Foreign Exchange Transactions Regulations (Notice No. 2023-26, Jul. 4, 2023) Art. 2-6-2 (resident and non-resident accounts) and Art. 2-6 (declaration to BOK Governor). Zero [HARDENING]; the four regimes kept separate; no invoice-currency or account/service entitlement asserted. South Korea advanced to publish_ready. No public surface.

financial_intelligence_unit_or_aml_autho.note: P8F-1 identified 2026-07-24: KoFIU is Koreas FIU for AML/CFT and suspicious/currency transaction reporting; AML context ONLY, not the traveller customs declaration and not FETA capital reporting.
